experiment: RHI-04R4.1 array observation and sampler provenance

erratum.overclaim: RHI-04R4 described the array and sampler identity chain as verified end to end
erratum.what_was_verified: the package validator's contract, against hand-built packages
erratum.what_was_not: the producer: NoteImageBinding, CommitPendingImages, NoteSnapshotTaken and the exporter's sampler filter were never called by a test
erratum.invalid_test: ASamplerFromAnotherDrawCannotSatisfyTheDeclaration asserted a different package than the one it built and never tested its named invariant
erratum.lesson: a validator test proves the validator, not the pipeline

defects.name: only the first array element was observed
defects.detail: one record per descriptor write, using image_bindings[image_binding_idx] only

defects.name: snapshots derived bindings from flattened image indices
defects.detail: unified = first_image_binding + binding_index, so a two-element array at binding 4 produced snapshots at 4 and 5

defects.name: the image-sampler association ignored provenance
defects.detail: the exported list was filtered by draw but the association searched the unfiltered collection

first_unresolved_invariant: no runtime evidence exists that any draw has a complete descriptor set
